This repository is a portfolio project: Hospital Patient Flow Analysis for "Chilungamo District Hospital", a fictional Malawian district hospital.

Hard rules for every change:
1. All data is synthetic and generated by a simulation. Never describe it as real. Keep the disclaimer in the README and in any dashboard footer.
2. Never hard-code a finding, statistic or number in prose. Every number in README.md, docs/ and reports/ must be produced by code and written to results/*.json or results/*.csv, then inserted into the text by a script.
3. Reproducibility: fixed random seed 42 by default, all parameters in config/default.yaml, one command regenerates everything.
4. Every new module needs pytest tests. Run the tests and show the output before saying a task is done.
5. Python 3.11, type hints, docstrings, ruff for linting. No notebooks for core logic: logic lives in src/patient_flow, notebooks only call it.
6. Report negative or inconclusive results honestly. Do not tune the simulation to get a nicer result.
7. When a method is applied to simulated data, state in the docs that results reflect the simulation assumptions, not real hospital performance.
8. Do not use em dashes in any text you write.
